title: Naomi NDEs 9420 NDE 9420
content: When I was 6, I was lying on the couch. There was a window next to me. I suddenly stopped breathing and then felt the most peaceful moment. I then noticed I could float. So I elevated upwards and went through the wall. My soul or spirit knew where exactly to go. Then high above the house, I saw a Being full of a strong, bright but gentle light that did not hurt my eyes. I was a happy child, but I never felt so much Happiness as being with this Being. I didn't know who he was since I was only 6 years old. (Later, I knew I was in front of God) He came to me. I was the happiest; like an endless Happiness, as I was close to him. I started jumping around him like a deer jumps when playing. He smiled at me and felt happy with me. I had 199% brain capacity. I understood why I was born and the reason was to be with him. I felt an incredible, weightless feeling. I remember this place felt way more real than life on earth. I never felt so loved and accepted like in this experience. He was young and full of love. Happiness is the best feeling I remember, as well as the feeling to be with him. But I hardly find words to describe entirely the feeling that his love and presence made me feel. It was like going back to my real home and with my real family. I was having so much fun with him, I wanted to stay there. He was totally accepting of me. He was not judging me for being annoying, or jumping too much. The more I jumped and laugh around him, the happiest he was with me. That's why I felt great acceptance and no judgment of my actions. Suddenly, I went back to my body. My grandma was a nurse who was giving me CPR. I remember feeling a heavy and unclean feeling to be back in my body, which was the opposite of where I had been. I had never felt depressed during my childhood until my grandma brought me back to 'life.' I felt instantly sad. When I was 26 years old, I had a pulmonary embolism due to taking birth control pills. I had two clots in one lung. I saw a dark tunnel. As soon I saw the light, I wanted to walk towards it because I knew that light from before. It was him. All I wanted to do was to reach the light. I couldn't see around me as it was really dark. The first step I took, someone stopped me by putting a giant arm on my chest. It was strong but really gentle and never would hurt me. I push the arm away and said, 'Excuse me, I have to go. The arm stopped me again. I felt angry. Without talking, the Being mentioned my four-year old daughter. I didn't communicate with words. It was more like telepathy. I let him know that my daughter didn't need me and that would be ok. I reasoned that if something bad happens, she will be back home here with us. He would not let me pass because it wasn't my time. I should be happy. Yet for years, I felt he brought me back to suffer more since this life has been hell. The only thing I know for sure is that there life after death and it is way more real than this one. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1987 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes CPR given Other: I had two NDEs. One happppened when I was 6 years old. I suddenly stopped breathing. The second experience was completely different. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I know I came back differently. I came back from those experiences with an incredible sense of intuition Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was normal Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Was normal Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes At the end of the tunnel during the second, the Being with the light was the same as in my first NDE Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Weightless feeling. Happiness with 100% joy in immense love. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of No return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? No comment. When I was 6, I had no religion and my family never mentioned God. I didn't know he existed, until I had the experience. I understood many things in life. In my second NDE, I was 26 years old. I was Christian but never went to church. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes What is your religion now? No comment. After what I've lived, I strongly believe in God. I clearly saw and felt him when I was 6 years old in the first NDE. After the second NDE, I got closer to God. This was not through religion, but through the love and experiences I had. I understood religion doesn't get us closer to God. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I'm more empathetic and understand more about behaviors. I can feel when someone I care for is crying, even if they are thousands of miles away from me. I can feel sadness from them. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Yes Now I know the being was Jesus. I didn't know back then about him. I was only 6 During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I developed a great sense of intuition and awareness towards living things. I strongly believe in Holism Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I was confused and didn't know at the time what exactly had happened and if I was just dreaming How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Intuition Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Uncertain

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Later identified as God; later states the being was Jesus.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: First NDE: stopped breathing at age 6 and received CPR. Second NDE: pulmonary embolism due to birth control pills (two clots in one lung).

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: At 26, Christian but never went to church; at 6 had no religion mentioned in family.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two NDEs: first included OBE and encounter with a being of light; second included a dark tunnel and being prevented from reaching the light by a gentle but strong arm, with telepathic communication about her daughter and that it was not her time.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Encounter with the same light/being across both NDEs.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reports '199% brain capacity' and jumping around the being 'like a deer jumps when playing'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was like going back to my real home and with my real family.”; “I remember feeling a heavy and unclean feeling to be back in my body.”; “Without talking, the Being mentioned my four-year old daughter.”
